summary.text: Melissa Ratcliff is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin Senate representing District 16, based in Cottage Grove.
She previously served on the Dane County Board of Supervisors, District 36, from 2018 to 2024, and she sits on the Committee on Administrative Rules and the Joint Legislative Audit Committee.

paragraphs.text: Ratcliff was born in Green Bay, Wisconsin, graduated from Wausau East High School in 1995, and earned a paralegal certificate from Madison College in 2000.
The Legislature's page lists her occupation as paralegal.
Her listed prior offices are the Dane County Board of Supervisors, District 36, from 2018 to 2024, and Cottage Grove Village Board trustee from 2018 to 2022.
She is a former secretary of the Cottage Grove Optimist Club, was appointed to the Governor's Task Force on Broadband Access, and is a member of the Nuclear Power Summit Board.
